final: SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') as status, COUNT(sc.cureregistry) as count, CAST(COUNT(sc.cureregistry) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation) as share FROM scanconservation sc LEFT JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') ORDER BY status
